values.meaning: duration of camouflage and decaying bonus move speed
bonus movement speed gained, decaying over the duration
values.binNote: Wiki gives base bonus MS as 45% (percent of base move speed); bin's BaseMoveSpeed=45 matches as the flat percent value. The per-lethality scaling (2% per 1 Lethality) is not represented by a named bin row; PykeW#MoveSpeed is tooltip-only and its stat29 term likely encodes this but is unlabeled.

mechanics.claim: Attacking or casting abilities ends Ghostwater Dive immediately, removing camouflage and the move speed buff.
mechanics.quote: Attacking or casting abilities ends ''Ghostwater Dive'' immediately.

mechanics.claim: A basic attack only breaks the stealth at the end of the attack windup, not immediately on cast.
mechanics.quote: Using a basic attack breaks the stealth at the end of the attack windup.

mechanics.claim: Nearby enemy champions within 1500 units are alerted to Pyke's presence and whether he can execute them with his ultimate, but this has no damage-fight effect.
mechanics.quote: Enemy champions within 1500 units of '''Pyke''' are alerted of his presence and whether he can execute them with {{ai|Death from Below|Pyke}}.
